description: Na₄TiAs₂O₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 57°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.55 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.68 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.55 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 62°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.55 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, and corners with four AsO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-62°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.03 Å. There are two inequivalent As sites. In the first As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 49-62°. There are a spread of As-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.76 Å. In the second As site, As is bonded to four O atoms to form AsO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-64°. There are two shorter (1.70 Å) and two longer (1.76 Å) As-O bond lengths. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one As atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and one As atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₃As trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one As atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ti, and one As atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one As atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one As atom.
